title: Marble Skill Taxonomy: 1,590 school micro-topics connected by 3,221 prerequisite edges as a graph

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Marble skill taxonomy maps what a child learns across primary school as a connected graph, not the usual flat list of standards. This breaks it into 1,590 teachable micro topics, each with an age range and evidence for mastery. then wires three 22 221 prerequisite edges between them.
